name: footer
title: Footer
description: A site footer: an oversized wordmark cut off by a hairline horizon and lit from one corner, over an aside and columns of links.

examples.name: footer-demo
examples.title: Footer
examples.description: Wordmark, an address, social links and a status line, then five columns of links.

examples.name: footer-simple
examples.title: Without a wordmark
examples.description: Just the aside and the columns, for pages where the name is already in the header.

examples.name: footer-wordmark
examples.title: Any name
examples.description: The wordmark is sized to fill the width, whatever its length and whatever the brand's heading font.

examples.name: footer-status
examples.title: Status
examples.description: FooterStatus in each tone. The words carry the status; the dot repeats it.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The name drawn oversized across the top and cropped at the bottom. Decorative and hidden from screen readers. Leave it out for no wordmark.

props.name: aside
props.description: The start column: an address, FooterSocialLinks, a FooterStatus.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Names the link columns' navigation landmark for screen readers.

props.name: title
props.description: The column's heading. It also names the column's list for screen readers.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. All of React Aria's Link props are accepted.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the destination. Required, because the link shows only an icon.

props.name: tone
props.description: The dot's colour. The words carry the meaning; the dot repeats it.

keyboard.action: Moves through the social links, then every link in column order.

notes: Renders a footer landmark (contentinfo when it is the page's footer) with a navigation landmark named by navLabel.
Each column's links are a list named by its title.
The wordmark is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.
Social links are icon-only and require aria-label; they are at least the control height, above the 24px target minimum.

do: Keep the wordmark to one short word; it is sized to fill the footer's width.
Write the status in words; the dot only repeats it.
dont: Don't rely on the wordmark to name the brand for screen readers.
Don't put more than six columns in one footer.
